newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cluff says finds 15 more diamonds.
newsitem.headline: Cluff says finds 15 more diamonds.

text.p: Cluff Resources Pacific NL said on Friday it had found more diamonds in the Copeton Dam region in the north of New South Wales.
Cluff said it recovered 15 gem-quality diamonds and a boart (finely crystalline industrial stone) during trial mining of the Round Mount prospect on the edge of the Copeton Dam property.
The diamonds were found about 650 metres from Cluff's Streak of Luck mine, where some 200 gem-quality diamonds were discovered in May.
The diamonds found at Round Mount weighed a total of three carats, Cluff said.
The largest gem was a white stone shaped as a teardrop weighing 0.5 carats, Cluff said.
The diamonds are approximately 50 percent white and 50 percent yellow, it said.
